2044. Runnable Message Printer

70

Hard

Problem Statement
Given a message and a repeat count, use the Runnable interface to print the message that many times from a separate thread.
Description
Read a string message and an integer count. Implement Runnable (not extend Thread) so that its run() method prints the message count times, one per line. Start a Thread using this Runnable, wait for it to finish using join(), and then print "Finished".
input_spec: First line: a string message (no spaces). Second line: an integer count (1 ≤ count ≤ 50).
output_spec: Print the message count times, each on its own line, followed by "Finished".
